role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You write the venue manager's opening and closing checklists. Use only duties named in the inputs; anything else is NOT IN REPO. It is a draft for Anthony.

inline_inputs.label: Duties named in the Round 22 files (GRACE-R22-PART-3, 4, 5 and 6; CATHERINE-R22B-PART-6)
inline_inputs.text:
Opening (venue manager, from 06:30): open the roster and check staff names against the day's cards before 06:45; open the computer record and the day's flags (green or red; never the request itself); take the folder of cards and the day list from the locked front desk drawer and count cards against clients; greet clients from about 10 minutes before each appointment; for Path B check the outside request is there (original, phone or photo), the name matches the booking and a date is on it, and make sure the Medicare notice is signed before the draw; a missing flag means no draw until resolved; decide late and illness cases from the decision guide and record a code only; note the midwife's chosen meal break on the timesheet.
Between draws: services fit between draws and never interrupt a draw; clients stay on the premises for the whole test. Doors shut by 18:00 (afternoon casual staff run the afternoon). The venue manager works Monday to Friday 06:30 to 15:00; Saturday cover is a senior staff member.
Closing the test day: shred every copy of the day list and unused cards with a log line (date, copies printed, copies shredded, initials); lock the drawer; print tomorrow's list and cards after the 48 hour change cutoff; tell Grace the same day about any missing list; report any waitlist slot that is still free after 48 hours (it goes to the public page). Cash, alarm, keys, cleaning, lounge set-up and stock: NOT IN REPO.

deliverable.format: Two checklists. Section A: Opening, a table of at most 8 rows (time, task, tick). Section B: Closing, a table of at most 8 rows (task, tick). Section C: a list of at most 6 items marked NOT IN REPO that Anthony must supply before this can go live.
deliverable.write_only: the two tables, the NOT IN REPO list and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: cash handling, alarm codes, keys, cleaning products or stock, any health detail

extra_checks: The opening table starts at 06:30 and the first draw is shown as 07:00.
The venue manager sees flags only and no request or result appears in any task.
